What changed:

- Same-box rounding overlaps: new `_cut_rounding_overlaps` cuts overlaps ≤ `DEPTH_TOL_M` so the earlier run wins (via shared `_clip_depth_pieces`); no more `pieces overlap` crash.
- Same-box gaps: new `_intra_box_gaps` reports `gap` with `box_before == box_after`, and `_cover_stretches` now takes trimmed runs (union of runs) so gaps get no interval. Inter- and intra-issues are merged sorted by depth.
